task: DAT-001/DAT-002: direct acceptance evidence for default and injected persisted domain identifiers

assertions.DAT-001: RegisterPerson uses the production default ID generator when Config.IDs is nil. Returned and read-back person identifiers match and the stored text has canonical lowercase UUIDv7 format, version 7, and RFC UUID variant.
assertions.DAT-002: A deliberately substituted Config.IDs generator supplies the exact person identifier returned by RegisterPerson and read back from SQLite by login.

format_and_diff_checks: gofmt -l empty; git diff --check passed; working tree clean after commit
scope: One focused test file and two requirement evidence-note updates. No production changes, status changes, generator rewrites, legacy-ID migration, session selector changes, or statistical randomness tests. This is direct persisted-person evidence, not universal identifier or release qualification. No remote writes.
